## The finding

## Why this matters strategically

1. **A referenceable Indian deployment is achievable.** IISc did it. The obstacle
   is not procurement, regulation or price — it is that nobody in the incubation
   category has tried.
2. **Protrak proves the data-residency and price objections are survivable.**
   It runs on IISc Azure, deployed in under 6 months, at roughly 50% below
   competing ELM products.
3. **It raises the bar rather than lowering it.** A competitor now holds the
   reference in the adjacent category. StartupHub cannot claim the same in
   incubation until it ships one.
